description_for_human: Access USDA soil data, EPA water quality, AI crop recommendations, carbon credit calculations, precision agriculture tools, patent-pending environmental impact analysis, and multi-parameter planting optimization for any US county.
description_for_model: LeafEngines provides geo-specific agricultural intelligence for the United States with TurboQuant-accelerated offline AI (3-bit KV cache quantization, 6x memory reduction, up to 24K token context windows). It offers 10 tools: county_lookup (resolve names to FIPS codes), get_soil_data (USDA soil composition), agricultural_intelligence (AI crop recommendations — supports TurboQuant extended context), territorial_water_quality (EPA water quality), safe_identification (plant ID with toxic lookalike warnings), carbon_credit_calculator (carbon credit estimation), generate_vrt_prescription (variable rate prescription maps), environmental_impact_analysis (patent-pending multi-source fusion with TurboQuant multi-year trend analysis), planting_optimization (multi-parameter phenology model with TurboQuant iterative scenario modeling), and turbo_quant_capabilities (query supported models, memory profiles, and context modes for hardware-aware model selection). All locations use 5-digit FIPS county codes — call county_lookup first if the user provides a name. AI-powered tools accept optional context_mode ('standard'|'extended'|'maximum') and kv_cache_hint ('none'|'reuse'|'persist') parameters for TurboQuant optimization.
